english.title: Come from land possessing article for killing / taking game
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) on being searched by a constable in pursuance of Section 2 of the Poaching Prevention Act 1862, were found in possession of

(A)_[an article,]_
(B)_[articles,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE(S)..), which you had used for unlawfully killing or taking game

english.notes:
(i) Game includes hares, partridges, eggs of pheasants and partridges, woodcocks, snipes, rabbits, grouse, black or moor game and eggs of grouse, black or moor game (Sec 1).
(ii) Section 2 relates to any gun, part of a gun, cartridges and other ammunition, nets, traps, snares and other devices used for killing or taking game.
